model_basis: dev-profile measured gas per MAC times v0.1 MACs (attempt only, excluding 51.6 MB weight generation); labeled model, not measurement
conclusion: A NEAR contract can verify the dev profile exactly (matches golden vectors), but one production (v0.1) attempt exceeds the 300 Tgas transaction limit by orders of magnitude even before weight generation; a NEAR light client that re-executes ZeroFlux PoW is infeasible. Trust-minimization needs a succinct proof (STARK) of the PoW, verified on NEAR; until that is built and reviewed, the 2-of-3 committee remains.
